images.visualPurpose: Teach the Court Ready Hold and establish the master exercise title/cloud UI.
images.uiReference: this image becomes the approved UI master

generatedText.title: COURT READY HOLD
generatedText.instruction: Bend your knees and stay ready.

images.prompt: Use approved Bild 01. Same girl/outfit/gym, zero basketballs. Static feet shoulder-width, knees visibly bent, hips slightly back, torso upright, hands clearly in front, full body visible. Add exactly one bottom-left title COURT READY HOLD and one top-right white/turquoise rounded cloud Bend your knees and stay ready. Keep timer/progress safe zones clear.

images.visualPurpose: Teach a wide defensive hold with unmistakable arm and leg separation.

generatedText.title: DEFENSE WINGS HOLD
generatedText.instruction: Stay low and stretch your arms wide.

images.prompt: Use Bild 01 for character/world and Bild 04 for UI only. Same girl, zero basketballs. Wide stance, knees bent, torso upright, both arms straight sideways at shoulder height, palms open, full body visible. Title DEFENSE WINGS HOLD bottom-left, cloud Stay low and stretch your arms wide. top-right, matching Bild 04 exactly.

images.visualPurpose: Teach a stable overhead basketball hold.
images.visualForm: vertical static full-body pose with one ball overhead

generatedText.title: BALL OVERHEAD HOLD
generatedText.instruction: Hold the ball high and stand tall.

images.prompt: Use Bild 01 and Bild 04 UI reference. Same girl, exactly one plain orange basketball. Stand tall with both arms fully extended overhead holding the ball, full body and ball visible, not a shooting motion. Title BALL OVERHEAD HOLD and cloud Hold the ball high and stand tall. with locked UI and safe zones.

images.visualPurpose: Teach a clear side lunge while holding one basketball at chest level.

images.prompt: Use Bild 01 and Bild 04 UI reference. Same girl, exactly one basketball. Add locked title and cloud for SIDE LUNGE BALL HOLD.

images.visualPurpose: Teach a forward lunge with one basketball while keeping both legs readable.

images.prompt: Use Bild 01 and Bild 04 UI reference. Same girl, exactly one basketball.
